decisions.reason: The visible in-field guidance requirement does not necessarily change the existing field architecture or revoke the use of ordinary editable text.
The candidate already has a complete message-197 MODIFY recording persistent visible in-field help text and permission to duplicate it in the label and field.
Keeping instructional text visible does not change the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting during interaction.

Automatically clearing placeholder text on activation may conflict with the instruction never to leave a field without visible in-field text, but the source does not clarify whether activation should select the text, delay clearing until typing, or use separate persistent help text.
The decision about persistent visible help text does not change the calendar-dropdown date-entry method.
The checklist-and-dropdown control configuration remains valid and is not changed by the in-field help-text decision.
The source requires existing instructional text to remain visible but does not change its Danish language or specified date and subject text.
Visible in-field instructional text has no necessary effect on pasted-table stability or column containment.
The source concerns editable-field guidance and does not change bullet sizing, appearance, alignment, scaling, or color.
The supported Word environment and general reliability expectations remain unchanged.
The editable-field visual-cue decision does not change Enter-key bullet creation behavior.
Persistent in-field instructional text does not alter the legacy-content paste workflow, stability expectations, test files, or unresolved formatting procedure.
